seed_ledger.name: Abilene 2.0 and Abilene 3.0
seed_ledger.reason: EXISTING_ROW. Energy Transfer says it completed another 14-mile lateral off Hugh Brinson in Abilene in Q2 2026, which matches Abilene 2.0 (14 mi, 24 inch, Jones, Shackelford, Taylor, filed 2025-08-12). The EIA August 2026 workbook lists three Energy Transfer laterals for Oracle's Abilene campus (row P8318 Abilene Laterals). Abilene 3.0 is 20.5 mi, 24 inch, Shackelford County; it is most likely the third lateral, but it could instead serve a different Oracle site, since Energy Transfer says three Oracle data centers, two in Texas. Tag lead: DataCenter for P8318, with sourced lengths of 22.5 km (14 mi) and 33 km (20.5 mi) as an Update. Searches run: 9. Sources: Energy Transfer Q2 2026 8-K (14-mile lateral in Abilene); EIA August 2026 workbook (three Oracle laterals); Texas Railroad Commission reports 25-NC-190 and 25-NC-191 (lengths, diameter); Energy Transfer Q3 2025 release (Oracle supply to three data centers, new lateral from Hugh Brinson); permit 10370 is Energy Transfer's general intrastate permit, so it is no tie.

seed_ledger.name: Abilene DC 1, LLC
seed_ledger.reason: NEW_ROW. Abilene DC 1, LLC is the Crusoe Energy Systems entity holding the air permit for the Stargate Abilene campus turbines; it filed a 3.07 mi (4.9 km), 16 inch natural gas line in Taylor County, start 2025-03-24, T-4 pending. Sponsor and project are named; endpoints unknown, and it may lie partly inside the plant fence. Separate from P8318, which is the Energy Transfer laterals. Same entity also filed Goodnight Gas Pipeline (1.5 mi, 20 inch, Armstrong County, 2026-03-01) which is outside this seed and not checked for a data center tie. Searches run: 8. Sources: Texas Railroad Commission report 25-NC-074 (specs); Compute Atlas (entity is Crusoe, air permit holder); Cleanview (Stargate Abilene campus); roster grep (no Crusoe or Abilene DC row).
